summary: Implemented and fully verified Phase 2 of 7 of the stack-PR-submission plan: review-stack-prepare.sh's cut now selects tasks (--milestone/--batch/--tasks, --stack-id), attributes each to a landing proof or a fallback commit-subject convention, merges shared_paths/--merge pairs and pulls in an unmerged path-overlapping earlier task, groups units into components over dependency edges and path overlap, orders each component topologically with an ancestry tie-break and a landed-order contradiction refusal, and assigns each unit a branch and a base -- printing the result and writing nothing. Suite grew from 19 to 28 cases, all passing; the order_contradiction refusal was empirically confirmed load-bearing by disabling and restoring its guard. Committed cleanly as one phase commit on top of Phase 1. Phases 3-7 (the actual cut/manifest ref-writing, restack, handoff integration, /merge stack mode, redeploy + second-repository demonstration) remain, each substantial git-plumbing and fixture work.

artifacts.summary: Phase 2 completion state, key decisions (selection gather-vs-validate split, the 5 Phase-1 assertions repointed to show, the untested --order chain simplification, the untested pull-in refusal branch), and the Phase 3 starting point.
